wt_revert.rule: per lineage group with >= 200 cells: mean within-cell panel proportions; per group held by >= 3 other wild-type samples: log(mean + 1e-5) fitted on stage day by least squares, read at the reference's day; t3_decompose.gene_factor of that trend against the reference's group means (weights: the reference's group sizes; eps 1e-5; clip 0.25-4); exponent 0.5
